metrics.label: Land-value index
metrics.unit: 0–100, vs. land of the same density
metrics.method: Mean percentile of the Bodenrichtwerte (2026-01-01) at the area's homes among Berlin's residential zones of the same kind (houses vs. flats); 63 of 63 home sample points lie in residential zones, 0% of them in zones for houses.

metrics.label: Typical land value
metrics.unit: EUR/m² of plot, median at homes
metrics.method: Median Bodenrichtwert (2026-01-01) over the area's homes; 63 of 63 home sample points lie in residential zones.

metrics.label: School leavers with Abitur

metrics.label: To Alexanderplatz
metrics.method: Door-to-door public transport from the region's resident-weighted centre, routed over the VBB weekday-peak timetable (Thursday 2026-11-12, 07:00-09:00); walking to and from stops included. Straight-line estimate where no route is found.

metrics.label: Traffic noise

metrics.method: Resident-weighted mean of the Planungsraum classes for NO₂/PM (2023 measurements); covers 100% of residents.

metrics.label: Summer heat
metrics.method: Resident-weighted mean of the Planungsraum classes for day and night heat (Klimamodell 2022); covers 100% of residents.

metrics.label: Car parks within 300 m

metrics.method: 22,853 registered residents (31 Dec 2024) ÷ 0.711 km².
